c.installNotes: clangd ships inside LLVM. Linux: `apt install clangd` / `dnf install clang-tools-extra`. macOS often has it under Xcode — try `xcrun --find clangd`.

go.installNotes: Requires Go on PATH. Binary lands in $(go env GOPATH)/bin.

lua.installNotes: Non-mac: download a release from https://github.com/LuaLS/lua-language-server/releases and put `lua-language-server` on PATH.

python.installNotes: Microsoft's Pyright. Static-analysis focused, very fast.

typescript.installNotes: Or: brew install typescript-language-server. The `typescript` package must be reachable too.

zig.installNotes: Non-mac: download a release from https://github.com/zigtools/zls/releases or build from source.
